# Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas

# Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-11-06 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] AtlasGov programmatic-access documentation lists Atlas Online Archives, Atlas Triggers, MongoDB Charts, and Atlas Device SDKs as unavailable; it also explicitly states that Atlas Stream Processing is unavailable. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md
- [statement] Atlas Online Archives, Atlas Triggers, MongoDB Charts, and Atlas Stream Processing are unavailable in AtlasGov. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features/ · keywords: Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md
- [statement] When integrated with Datadog, AtlasGov uses the Datadog for Government site `US1-FED`; Datadog lists its site URL as `https://app.ddog-gov.com` and its site parameter as `ddog-gov.com`. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] AtlasGov uses Datadog for Government US1-FED for its Datadog integration. Datadog identifies US1-FED with app.ddog-gov.com and documents that its sites are independent and cannot share data across sites. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://docs.datadoghq.com/getting_started/site/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The mongodb/agents repository explicitly excludes AtlasGov from support for its Atlas Agent Engine templates; this restriction applies to those templates rather than all possible AI applications using AtlasGov. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/agents

## Facts and statements

- [statement] AtlasGov supports a subset of commercial Atlas features and some unique features; commercial Atlas documentation alone does not establish AtlasGov feature availability. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features.md · keywords: Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/atlasgov-considerations.md
- [statement] AtlasGov requires cluster tier `M20` or higher and excludes Free, Flex, and `M10` clusters. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/atlasgov-considerations.md
- [statement] AtlasGov supports MongoDB Search, but does not support dedicated Search Nodes: mongot runs alongside MongoDB processes on the same nodes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-search.md
- [statement] AtlasGov does not support driver-native Search index management commands; its Search guide specifies the Atlas Administration API or Atlas CLI for managing Search indexes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-search.md
- [statement] AtlasGov SCRAM database users must use `SCRAM-SHA-256`. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/atlasgov-considerations.md
- [statement] AtlasGov supports Atlas Kubernetes Operator and the HashiCorp Terraform MongoDB Atlas Provider for programmatic resource management. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md · keywords: Atlas for Government feature differences from commercial Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features/
- [statement] MongoDB Atlas CloudFormation resources support AtlasGov; the repository recommends IsMongoDBGovCloud=true in the profile secret and states that an explicit BaseUrl takes precedence over that flag. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongodbatlas-cloudformation-resources/blob/master/README.md
- [statement] The Gen2 feature-comparison footnote states that commercial Atlas supports Gen2 clusters on AWS and GCP, whereas AtlasGov supports Gen2 clusters only on AWS. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features.md
- [statement] MongoDB Search and MongoDB Vector Search are marked supported for both commercial Atlas and AtlasGov in the feature comparison matrix. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features/
- [statement] The comparison matrix marks Atlas Data Federation, Voyage AI, and Global Clusters as available in commercial Atlas but unmarked for AtlasGov. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features/
- [statement] The comparison matrix marks Prometheus Integration and Push logs to AWS S3 as available in commercial Atlas but unmarked for AtlasGov. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features/
- [statement] In addition to standard Atlas logging, AtlasGov records usernames and IP addresses for failed login attempts, temporary lockouts, and failed API digest authentications. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md
- [statement] AtlasGov prohibits backup restores between standard projects and government-region-only projects; source and target must remain in the same project region-usage category. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md
- [statement] AtlasGov customer-managed encryption keys must follow project boundaries: government-region-only projects use keys in government regions, while AWS Commercial region-only projects use AWS Commercial region keys. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md
- [statement] The feature comparison matrix marks Backup Compliance Policy and BI Connector as supported in both commercial Atlas and AtlasGov. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features/
- [statement] The AtlasGov API documentation lists Atlas Device SDKs among unavailable products; this does not establish that the SDKs remain available in current commercial Atlas. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md
